workflows.events:
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    # Metadata changes do not alter admission. Gate only source-head lifecycle
    # events so title, labels, milestones, and draft promotion cannot create
    # redundant queue work.
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]
    paths:
      - 'scripts/solo-replay-portability-diagnostic.mjs'
      - 'scripts/diagnose-solo-replay-portability.mjs'
      - 'scripts/solo-replay-portability-diagnostic.test.mjs'
      - 'docs/performance/fixtures/solo-replay-portability/first-eight-39109911286.json'
      - 'scripts/run-solo-replay-portability.mjs'
      - 'scripts/test-solo-replay-portability-hook.mjs'
      - 'docs/performance/solo-replay-portability-797-plan.json'
      - '.github/workflows/solo-native-package-consumer.yml'
      - 'docs/performance/solo-remote-de332-correctness-tooling-plan.json'
      - 'docs/performance/solo-next-geometric-de332-tooling-plan.json'
      - 'scripts/test-solo-de332-correctness.mjs'
      - 'scripts/test-solo-next-de332-admission.mjs'
      - 'scripts/solo-qualification-next-route.mjs'
      - 'scripts/solo-remote-sustained.mjs'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      lane:
        description: 'Fixed797 qualification lanes; later phases require reviewed predecessors or separate Cocoa codec control. Review exact source before expansion; no automatic retries.'
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: first-eight
        options:
          [
            first-eight,
            next,
            cocoa,
            raster,
            hud-cpu,
            readiness,
            touch,
            app-overhead,
            journal-cost,
            timing,
            lifecycle,
            shared-return,
            demo-recovery,
            demo-resources,
            replay-portability,
            frame-trace,
          ]

      phase:
        description: 'One fixed timing or lifecycle phase; ignored by other lanes. No automatic continuation.'
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: none
        options:
          [
            none,
            cold-first30,
            warm-first30,
            sentry-latency,
            long-rail-latency,
            large-capture-erosion,
            jammer-steering,
            retry,
            soak,
            long29,
          ]

on:
  workflow_run:
    # Reconcile when any PR validation workflow completes, including a failure
    # that must disarm an earlier decision. The controller also waits for every
    # non-waived exact-head check already registered on the commit.
    workflows:
      - Validate source for continuous main
      - Appearance preview
      - Industrial feature verification
      - Company edition candidates
      - Assemble full-test release evidence
      - Community hosted acceptance
      - Community MinIO recovery
    types: [completed]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types:
      [
        opened,
        reopened,
        synchronize,
        edited,
        labeled,
        unlabeled,
        milestoned,
        demilestoned,
        ready_for_review,
        converted_to_draft,
      ]
  pull_request_review:
    branches: [main]
    types: [submitted, dismissed]
workflows.concurrency:
concurrency:
  group: fastline-merge-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests[0].number || github.run_id }}
  # Metadata changes are cheap and read current state. Serializing them avoids
  # cancelled controller checks poisoning GitHub's merge-state rollup.
  cancel-in-progress: false

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: Same-repository open PR based directly on main
        required: true
        type: string
      main_sha:
        description: Exact current main and workflow-controller SHA
        required: true
        type: string
      head_sha:
        description: Exact candidate PR head SHA
        required: true
        type: string

    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:

      - 'scripts/solo-qualification-shared-mode.mjs'

nativeJobs.name: cocoa
nativeJobs.header:
cocoa:
    # Explicit separate codec control; never starts from a PR or a Linux lane.
    if: github.repository == 'mekhovov/revealline' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.lane == 'cocoa'
    runs-on: macos-15-intel
    timeout-minutes: 28

nativeJobs.name: correctness
nativeJobs.header:
correctness:
    # Explicit fixed-source manual selection on main; fresh owners remain mandatory.
    if: github.repository == 'mekhovov/revealline' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.lane == 'first-eight'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 145

nativeJobs.name: declare
nativeJobs.header:
declare:
    # Manual Next only after review of the fresh first-eight result; never automatic continuation.
    if: github.repository == 'mekhovov/revealline' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && inputs.lane == 'next'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5

nativeJobs.name: sustained
nativeJobs.header:
sustained:
    needs: declare
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.jobMinutes }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 6
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.declare.outputs.matrix) }}

nativeJobs.header:
raster:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      max-parallel: 2
      matrix:

nativeJobs.name: touch

touch:

    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
